unresolved.from: The independent decimal oracle of `🧪️tests/🧪️number-facets` (staged-argument number facets) over `🧫️fixtures/🧫️number-facets`: it recomputes every refusal's bound in display units (`value × displayFactor` to twelve significant digits) beside the shown unit.

One structured observation as `semio-framework-trace`'s `TraceRecord::to_json_line` writes it: one JSON object per line on the configured sink (`SEMIO_TRACE_SINK` = `stderr` | `stdout` | `none` | `file:<path>`), admitted by `SEMIO_TRACE_LEVEL`. `requestId` is the span id: the admission record of a long-lived span (a socket) and the record that ends it carry the same id. Absent identity fields are omitted, never written as null. The event vocabulary an operator may alert on is `⏱️trace/🧫️fixtures/🛰️span-vocabulary/🔣️.json`.
